quality_notes: SAF rows preserve UK ETS/SAF Mandate thresholds, lifecycle potential, eligibility and consultation parameters; none are treated as observed flight emissions.
Cross-boundary CCS rows preserve permit/regulator options, monitoring infrastructure and illustrative HyNet arrangements; no CO2 throughput or realised savings are inferred.
Domestic-maritime rows preserve final compliance rules, cap-adjustment allowance quantities, survey responses and funding; allowance/funding values are not emissions.
UK ETS Registry public reports page was deliberately not packaged because its dynamic table did not provide stable line-level locators in the browsing readback.
